notes: All runs preserved. Current post-review measurements fail the frozen 1.20 ms p95 gate. An unchanged 6ee23b9 build in a filtered temporary snapshot also measured 2.30 ms on the same host; this suggests host measurement drift but does not waive the gate. No unrelated processes or real daemon were stopped. Pre-review passing sample is not the delivered result.

result.method: keydown in Electron renderer (capture phase) or direct CLI outer-PTY write, to arrival of output establishing expected command-bar character and following block-cursor cell; Unicode 11 parsed offline; 50 warmup, 300 samples, 15/20/25 ms gaps; Ctrl+U every 60 keys
result.limits: Output arrival, not physical display paint. Direct CLI baseline excludes Terminal.app input/paint and uses system Node; it is not a Terminal.app measurement. No app-versus-Terminal release claim.
